headline: Average net salary exceeded 5,700 lei in September, but inflation continued to erode purchasing power - Forbes.ro
summary: Romania's average net salary exceeded 5,700 lei in September, but inflation continued to reduce purchasing power, according to Forbes Romania.
why: Wage growth relative to inflation drives household consumption and central-bank policy expectations in Romania, a regional EU economy.
